defect_summary: Tag-time checker-digest signature landed in pull request #72 after ship pull request #71 had already merged.
unsuitable_process: The owner-signature round-trip (ADR 0057) is requested as a follow-up PR after a ship merge. There is no HUMAN_DECISION that must complete before CREATE_PR to main. v0.6.0 landed armor on the line before the ship PR; this session inverted that order.
climb_steps: Signature was requested after the ship PR existed.
Planner has no AWAIT_SIGNATURE before CREATE_PR.
ADR 0057 / ADR 0049: owner signature is HUMAN_DECISION before the tag candidate is offered to main.

repo_touch.belief: ADR 0025 — defects name unsuitable process, not agents
